prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single transparent dialogue head portrait for a dark medieval RPG, designed to read at 74 by 100 pixels. Make a substantive newly drawn portrait, not a crop of the reference body.
Input images in order: 1 is Lema's approved identity mother image; 2 Mara, 3 Iwo, 4 Leiya, 5 Tore are STYLE AND HEAD-FRAMING references only. Do not copy their identity.
Subject: Lema / 雷玛 / OSB-NPC-LEMA, a lean narrow-shouldered man in his mid-to-late thirties, the neighbor who wants an independent gate and to leave shared-fence obligations without denying past help. Preserve the mother's tousled short chestnut-brown hair, uneven fringe, straight nose, square lower jaw with light short stubble, small closed straight mouth, visible ear and restrained worried-yet-firm sidelong gaze. Latest character card specifies pale skin and a washed-out coarse homespun outer smock: at the very bottom show a simple worn faded oatmeal-gray smock collar over a little muted moss-green inner neckline. No heroic cape, no armor, no brooch. Skin should be visibly paler than Kofu's wheat tan. Mild under-eye fatigue and natural nasolabial plane identify thirties, not a teenager or a deeply wrinkled elderly man.
Style: emulate the four low-resolution reference portraits, coarse intentionally constructed angular pixel clusters, connected broad nose and cheekbone planes, earth palette, dark broken contour, hard-edged contiguous shapes. Very SMALL narrow dark eyes, only 1-2 muted warm-gray sclera pixels at logical size, slightly uneven brow tension. Light stubble in a few connected shadow clusters, not beard hair noise. Adult reserved and thoughtful expression. No pretty generic doll face, no glossy eyes, no anime geometry, no smooth airbrush or tiny speckle texture.
Composition: portrait canvas aspect 74:100. Entire hair silhouette and ear outline wholly inside frame with real transparent clearance on all four sides. A very large face: cheekbones about 63% of canvas width and brow-to-chin about half canvas height. Head and tousled hair occupy almost all image height, visible neck is short and collar only the lowest 10-12%, no broad shoulders or chest. Slight three-quarter toward viewer left as mother. No hair tufts or ears clipped; about 4-5% clear margin around every extremity including bottom collar.
Output: exactly one isolated head portrait on true transparent alpha. At most 32 colors intended, binary sharp transparency, no background, no border, no text or labels, no collage. Distinct personal likeness and broad light/shadow planes matter more than decorative detail. Do not depict gate, key, livestock, documents, handover, agreement or a completed story outcome.
